title: Implement page type detection heuristics
description:
Implement type detection using:
1. og:type meta tag (article, product, website, etc.)
2. JSON-LD @type (Recipe, SoftwareApplication, etc.)
3. URL patterns (github.com = Open Source, docs = SaaS, etc.)
4. Content keywords in title/description

Detection should prioritize: og:type > JSON-LD > URL patterns > keywords.

Acceptance criteria:
- og:type detection reads meta tag
- JSON-LD detection parses script tag
- URL pattern matching works
- Content keyword fallback works
- Returns normalized type string ('blog', 'saas', 'recipe', 'opensource', 'portfolio', 'ecommerce')

title: Shareable URL: QR code generator for share links
description:
Add QR code generation to the share link feature.

Plan spec: 'Copy share link' button exists. A QR code generator button should appear that generates a QR code of the current share URL — useful for mobile testing (scan with phone to see how URL previews in mobile apps). When shared in platforms that support OG cards, VISTA itself should render a meta card showing the inspected URL's score.

Current state: shareResults() and '#shareBtn' exist. The URL is shared via query parameter (?url=...). No QR code generation is implemented.

Tasks:
- Add a 'QR code' button next to the share button in the summary bar
- On click, generate a QR code of the current vista.jedarden.com/?url=... share URL
- Display QR code in a small modal or popover
- Use a lightweight client-side QR library (qrcode.js or similar, ~10KB)
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion (no animation on QR display)

title: Shareable URL: URL hash state encoding for What If, compare, and tab state
description:
Implement URL hash-based state encoding for full shareability.

Plan spec: Additional state encoded in URL hash (stateless, no server storage):
- Mode: #mode=compare&b=https://other.com
- Disabled tags (What If mode): #without=og:image,twitter:card
- Active tab: #tab=diagnostics

Current state: The URL input value is encoded as ?url= query param and auto-triggers inspection on load. However hash-based state (What If disabled tags, active tab, compare second URL) is not implemented.

Tasks:
- On What If tag disable, update URL hash: #without=og:image,twitter:card
- On tab switch, update URL hash: #tab=diagnostics
- On compare mode, encode second URL: #mode=compare&b=https://...
- On page load, parse hash and restore state (active tab, What If state, compare second URL)
- 'Copy share link' button should copy the full URL including hash state

title: Implement meta tag diff detection between hops
description:

Acceptance criteria:
- Compare metaTags between consecutive hops in redirectChain
- Highlight hops where meta tags are stripped (all tags lost)
- Highlight hops where specific tags change (e.g., noindex removed)
- Show diff as visual indicators in the chain diagram
- Display 'meta tag stripped' warning badges on affected hops
- Tested with redirects that strip/modify meta tags

title: Confetti: Full perfect-score celebration with shareable card
description:
Implement the full confetti celebration for perfect A+ score.

Plan spec: When all 31 platforms score A+, trigger canvas-confetti burst (2 sec, ~150 particles). Show toast: 'Perfect score! Your page is fully optimized across all 31 platforms.' with a share button. Share button generates: 'example.com scored A+ on all 31 platforms — verified by VISTA'. Golden glow on score badge. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Does NOT trigger on cached results. Does NOT trigger in Compare or Audit modes.

Current state: triggerConfetti() exists and calls canvas-confetti if available. The check for all 31 platforms having A+ grade exists (lines 639-642). hasCelebratedPerfectScore flag exists. However: (1) the 'perfect score' toast with share button is not implemented; (2) the shareable card text ('domain.com scored A+ on all 31 platforms') is not generated; (3) the golden glow CSS on the summary bar grade badge is not applied; (4) the mode guard (Compare/Audit modes skip confetti) is not verified.

Tasks:

- Guard: skip confetti+toast in Compare and Audit modes

title: Performance: Progressive rendering (HTML fetch → text → images → headers in parallel)
description:

Plan spec:
1. Instant (0ms): URL accepted, skeleton grid appears
2. HTML fetched (~500ms): Summary bar populates with score. Text-based card previews render.
3. Meta tags parsed (~600ms): All text-based cards render (Google, text portions of all cards)
4. Image probed (~1-3s): Image dimensions arrive. Cards with images fill in. Crop visualizer becomes available.
5. Headers analyzed (~600ms, parallel): Diagnostics tab populates.
6. Complete: Loading spinner stops.

Current state: The server does all steps synchronously in buildPreviewResult() and returns one large JSON blob. The client shows a loading overlay until the full response arrives. There is no streaming or progressive rendering — the client waits for everything (including image probe) before showing any results.

Tasks:
- Refactor /api/preview to use streaming JSON (SSE or chunked response) OR
- Split into multiple endpoints: /api/preview/meta (fast, ~600ms) + /api/preview/image (slower) + /api/preview/headers (parallel)
- Frontend shows text cards immediately when meta arrives, fills in image cards when probed
- Diagnostics tab becomes available when headers analyzed
